system.description:
Favoured weapon: Mace, Heavy

Granted power: Once/day: declare a Smite on an undead creature: on a hit, the target must make a Will save against your Class Save DC or be destroyed outright rather than just damaged. Advantage on saves vs necromantic effects.

Allegiance: Neutral Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Lathander in the World of Arneyan wiki.
